currentSessionCheckpoint.worktreeNote: The feature cleanup, documentation cleanup, and incremental GenieProof implementation changes are uncommitted. Preserve the worktree and inspect its current state before resuming; do not reset or clean it.

backend.enabledStartupBehavior: Persistence indexes are checked read-only; the explicit migration owns index creation.

implementationLimits.supportedClaim: The verifier's only in-scope claim is one current nominal annual interest-rate statement for India Post PPF. Other recognized financial statements are retained as UNSUPPORTED and are not verified.
implementationLimits.claimLimitBehavior: Extraction reports how many financial-claim statements were omitted; a truncated offer cannot be saved as a reviewed passport.
implementationLimits.sourceVerification: The source verifier abstains. In-scope claims return NOT_VERIFIABLE because source attestation and reuse permission are not qualified.
implementationLimits.customerMeaning: A signed record does not establish offer or sender legitimacy, investment safety, or whether the customer should invest.
implementationLimits.proofBreak: Monitoring, durable scheduling, source-change detection, revalidation, and alerts are not implemented; the UI keeps ProofBreak disabled.
implementationLimits.passportExportAndIndependentVerification: The UI exports a signed JSON passport. A local Node.js verifier checks an out-of-band Ed25519 trust store and deterministic finding replay; without qualified evidence it returns VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE.
implementationLimits.storage: There is no automatic retention policy or per-user storage quota. Deletion removes active app records but does not establish backup or oplog erasure. The UI now explicitly discloses saved claim retention until deletion.

preservedControls: Authenticated, strict, owner-scoped API routes with rate limiting and Cache-Control: no-store.
Ed25519-signed manifests bind case owner, claim submission, confirmed claims, findings, and revision metadata.
Submitted structured claims must match the server-side extraction before signing or persistence.
Synthetic or caller-supplied snapshot fields cannot create SUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED findings.
Manifest self-published keys are not trust anchors; offline verification requires configured external public keys.
